podcast.body: In 2015, the tour restarted on the 20th anniversary of the release of the band's first album. "The tour, restarted on July 4th in Dave's hometown of Washington, DC. It was the 20th anniversary of the release of the first food fighters album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This was the debut album released a little over a year after Kurt Cobain's death, in July 1995. Dave Grohl performed all the instruments himself on this record, effectively making it a solo project at the time. "And a little over a year later, the first Foo Fighters album was released. This would be July 1995."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
